concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-manage-access]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Business accounts Customer Area user and web-service credential role guide, including sole-proprietor IBAN PII and Transfers API v1 scope; roles do not prove access or operations.
warnings: Separate human Customer Area roles from web-services and legal-entity-management API credentials; listed roles are not assigned-permission proof.
View payment instrument PII needs the base role and is scoped to sole-proprietor Adyen-issued IBAN; Bank Transfer Initiation role is v1 only.
Provider index currently lacks adyen-business-accounts route; coordinator should add it for forward discovery.
